title: The Complete Works of Liudprand of Cremona
author: Liudprand of Cremona

_quarry.citation: Liudprand of Cremona. The Complete Works of Liudprand of Cremona. Translated by Paolo Squatriti. Medieval Texts in Translation. Washington, DC: Catholic University of America Press, 2007.
_quarry.notes: Three Latin works of the 10th-century Italian-Ottonian diplomat-bishop Liudprand: Antapodosis (a contemporary Italian history c. 887–949), the Historia Ottonis (covering Otto I's 962 imperial coronation and aftermath), and the bitterly partisan Relatio de Legatione Constantinopolitana (recording his 968 embassy to Nikephoros II Phokas). Squatriti's Catholic University edition is the standard one-volume English translation.
